title: The Clinical Study of Acute Pancreatitis Treated by TongFuSan
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether TongFuSan is effective in the treatment of acute pancreatitis with gastrointestinal dysfunction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis，both mild type and severe type

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant or suckling
* cancer in late time
* patient near death
